LanguageData.LP_AbyssHorde.label: abyssal horde
LanguageData.LP_AbyssHorde.description: Demons crawled out of the Abyss: those summoned by rituals but never bound, those who broke their bonds, and those pouring from abyssal rifts. They have no bases and do not negotiate; they only want to drag this world into the Abyss.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssHorde.ideoDescription: Everything falls. Everything will belong to the Abyss.
